concerns.text: The plan relies on a 'Static lookup table (data/omniopt_lookup.json)' for OmniOpt ground truth labels because 'NO verified source found'. The hypothesis requires mapping specific architecture/task pairs to 'optimal mechanism family' labels derived from the OmniOpt benchmark. Without a verified, accessible source (URL or repository) for the OmniOpt benchmark data, the ground truth labels cannot be programmatically verified or reproduced. Relying on a manually parsed static JSON file violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle VII (Ground Truth Alignment), as the labels cannot be re-derived from a canonical source. The plan must identify a verified source for the OmniOpt benchmark data or explicitly define a reproducible re-run protocol for the specific sub-experiments within the 6-hour limit.

The plan assumes '20 diverse model architectures' and '5+ optimizer families' are available in the OmniOpt benchmark. If the OmniOpt benchmark does not contain results for 20 diverse architectures (e.g., ResNet-18, small Transformers) across 5+ families, the dataset will be too small for the proposed 5-fold cross-validation and permutation test (FR-005, SC-002). The plan must verify that the cited OmniOpt source actually contains the required number of diverse architecture/optimizer pairs to support the statistical power of the study.
